positions.summary_short: Peter Koetsier prioritizes environmental and water-quality protection and responsible, sustainable development.
summary_bullets: Platform: Protecting Our Environment and Water Quality; Responsible and Sustainable Development.
Priorities include creating water quality and septic system testing protocols that lead to action where necessary.
Points to protected land tracts through the Corridor Project with the Georgian Bay Land Trust and water quality studies informing new policies.
positions.verbatim_quote: Vote for: Protecting Our Environment And Water Quality. Responsible And Sustainable Development.
positions.source_title: Peter Koetsier for Mayor - campaign website

positions.summary_short: Peter Koetsier wants better value for tax dollars and recognition of Georgian Bay's needs at the District.
summary_bullets: Priorities include better taxpayer value: leveraging his District groundwork for better services and value from taxes.
Wants the township's unique characteristics better recognized as the District undergoes a governance review under a provincially appointed Chair.
Eight years as mayor and District Councillor including five as Chair of Finance Committee.
positions.verbatim_quote: Better Value For Our Tax Dollars.
positions.source_title: Peter Koetsier for Mayor - campaign website

positions.summary_short: Peter Koetsier wants investment in MacTier, libraries and community facilities.
summary_bullets: Wants to invest in MacTier: continuing the ReFresh MacTier program with significant investment in facilities and programming.
Wants Port Severn library services upgraded to accreditation levels, as achieved in Honey Harbour and MacTier.
Cites past investments: docks, a new shelter with rink, and pickleball courts in Honey Harbour.
positions.verbatim_quote: Continuing the momentum of the ReFresh MacTier program by significantly investing in MacTier. This will cover both facilities and programming, making MacTier an even better place to live, work, and visit.
positions.source_title: Peter Koetsier for Mayor - campaign website

positions.summary_short: Peter Koetsier wants new solid waste service levels and taxation finalized with the District.
summary_bullets: Priority: finalizing new solid waste service levels, and associated taxation, with the District of Muskoka.
Notes the township provided discounted Food Cyclers and large item pick-up events after the District pulled out of that service.
positions.verbatim_quote: Finalizing new solid waste service levels, and associated taxation, with the District of Muskoka.
positions.source_title: Peter Koetsier for Mayor - campaign website

positions.summary_short: Peter Koetsier cites securing long-term District funding for Georgian Bay General Hospital.
summary_bullets: Lists securing long-term funding from the District of Muskoka for Georgian Bay General Hospital and the West Parry Sound Health Centre as an achievement.
positions.verbatim_quote: We have secured long-term funding from the District of Muskoka for Georgian Bay General Hospital and the West Parry Sound Health Centre.
positions.source_title: Peter Koetsier for Mayor - campaign website

positions.summary_short: Laurie Russell promises transparent decisions, responsible spending, fair services and lake protection.
summary_bullets: Will advocate for transparent decision-making, responsible spending, fair municipal services, and protection of the lakes and communities.
Says District Council decisions affect taxes, services, infrastructure, public safety and environment, deserving careful scrutiny and strong representation.
Brings 20+ years of senior business leadership and 7+ years of elected community leadership in budgeting and governance.
positions.verbatim_quote: Transparent decision-making. Responsible spending. Fair municipal services. Protecting the lakes and communities that make this area so special.
positions.source_title: Laurie Russell - Candidate for District Councillor, Wards 1 & 3 - campaign website

positions.summary_short: Allan Hazelton centers re-election on environmental action, transparency and financial accountability.
summary_bullets: Councillor since 2018, championing resident interests with a focus on environmental priorities.
Has led resident interests on environmental matters, dark sky lighting, noise concerns, water speed zones and floating dwellings.
Has tabled 50+ resolutions on effectiveness and efficiencies, transparency, and increasing the environmental focus of the township.
Does water quality sampling and testing; member of the Township Water Quality Monitoring Working Group.
positions.verbatim_quote: As your Councillor since 2018 I feel I have made a difference, championing resident interests with a focus on Environmental Priorities.
positions.source_title: Allan Hazelton - Area Councillor - Ward 4 - Georgian Bay Township - campaign website

positions.summary_short: Allan Hazelton worked to replace District-removed waste bins for water-access residents with private services.
summary_bullets: Worked with marinas and Honey Harbour businesses on private waste services to backfill the District of Muskoka's removal of waste bins for the water-access community.
positions.verbatim_quote: Worked with the Marinas and businesses in Honey Harbour to consider delivering private waste services to backfill the District of Muskoka's abandoning of the Water Access Community by removing the Waste Bins.
positions.source_title: Allan Hazelton - Area Councillor - Ward 4 - Georgian Bay Township - campaign website

positions.summary_short: Allan Hazelton supports a Honey Harbour education centre and serves on the library board.
summary_bullets: Supported the proposed William Grenville Davis Education Centre for the hamlet of Honey Harbour.
Serves on the Georgian Bay Township Public Library board.
positions.verbatim_quote: Supported the proposed William Grenville Davis Education Centre for the Hamlet of Honey Harbour.
positions.source_title: Allan Hazelton - Area Councillor - Ward 4 - Georgian Bay Township - campaign website

positions.summary_short: Donald Blais prioritizes child well-being, safe schools, belonging and graduation rates.
summary_bullets: Top concern is the well-being of children: a safe school, tools and training for staff, and a sense of belonging for families regardless of background, beliefs or orientation.
Supports the Committee for Children in Difficulty with the necessary budget.
Wants high graduation rates by helping children reach their full potential.
positions.verbatim_quote: Provide all the necessary tools and training to staff members to maintain a safe environment in our schools.
positions.source_title: Vote Donald Blais: School Trustee - votedonaldblais.ca

positions.summary_short: Donald Blais promises transparency and leans on 12 years as trustee and relationships with officials.
summary_bullets: Wants transparency: minimize closed-door discussions and maximize public debates.
Cites 12 years as a school trustee and good relations with provincial politicians, the Director of Education, superintendents and staff.
Supports traditional professions promotion to address AI labour-market changes and environmental education.
positions.verbatim_quote: Minimize closed-door discussions and maximize public debates.
positions.source_title: Vote Donald Blais: School Trustee - votedonaldblais.ca
